filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. For English, selections prioritized high-view, clear tutorials from established educational channels. For Arabic, selections were made from a smaller pool, focusing on the most relevant titles from channels specializing in data mining. All hard gates were applied, and no videos or channels were duplicated within a topic/language pair.
